notes.title: Arkya / 02 - Cites d'Ether
notes.notes: Cour monumentale: anneau ouvert, cristal suspendu, domes nervures, galeries, jardins et voyageur a echelle humaine.
notes.assets: Entirely procedural original mesh and curve geometry; no external textures.
notes.palette: Warm ivory, petroleum blue, turquoise enamel, coral textiles, satin bronze.
